messages:
jenna: Quick heads-up — we're releasing a Compliance Audit Kit for Private deployments (SOC2 + FedRAMP readiness). Package includes: checklist, customer-facing evidence bundle, auditor runbook, and a disposable staging environment auditors can hit. Pilot cohort starts next week. Pls read & ACK.

alex: Where do we host the kit? Link?

jenna: Upload is live: https://redwood.internal/priv-compliance-kit — contains markdown checklists, sample evidence PDFs, and an `audit-runbook.md`. Pilot schedule is in the top-level README. We need SRE to provision auditor staging envs and engineering to add short-lived access tokens.

alex: Got it. I'll spin up staging clusters Tue/Wed. Do we have resource quotas defined?

jenna: Quotas are in the kit under `infra/quotas.md`. Default pilot uses 2x T4s per cluster. If you need more, ping infra. Also include the `kms-attestation` artifact from the kit.

maria: DevEx will prep a customer-facing deck and email templates. Can someone own the legal review of the evidence bundle?

chris-legal: I'll take legal review. Please give us 48h notice before you hand off the bundle for an audit. Important: attach data-flow diagrams + KMS key rotation policy. I'll add comments on the first pass.

sam: For pipeline deals — can we offer a short \"audit readiness consult\" as a paid add-on? Need a one-pager and suggested list price to share with AE team.

jenna: Yes, we can. Maria — can you draft a 1-pager? I'll help with technical scope. Sam, please send a sample pricing range and target SLA for the consult.

ops-bot: Deployment job started: private-staging-cluster-jenna-1769802101

alex: Clusters are up. Endpoints: `https://staging-priv-jenna.redwood.local` — basic smoke test:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <AUDITOR_TOKEN>" \
  https://staging-priv-jenna.redwood.local/v1/models | jq .
```
Token is short-lived; see kit > `auth/auditor-tokens.md`.

chris-legal: Uploaded initial legal review notes to the kit: `evidence/legal-review-176980`. Key asks: explicit KMS attestation, proof of log retention, and auditor access expiry policy.

maria: Deck draft uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/priv-compliance-deck (draft v0.1). Added templates for `customer-intro` and `evidence-request`.

sam: Booked pilot session with AcmeCorp for Thu 10am PST. Invites sent to @chris-legal, @alex, @jenna. Adding AE notes into the CRM.

jenna: Great. Action items (short):
- alex: provision staging clusters & tests (due Tue EOD)
- chris-legal: finalize legal review (due Wed noon)
- maria: one-pager + deck update (due Wed EOD)
- sam: coordinate pilot demo & pricing (ongoing)
- eng: add audit logs + trace hooks for auditor visibility (sprint task)

Please ACK on this thread when you have the items assigned. :wave:

alex: ACK — will add monitoring hooks and post logs to the evidence bundle by Wed morning. :thumbsup:

chris-legal: ACK — will finish review by Wed.

maria: ACK — updating deck now.

sam: ACK — sharing pricing notes with you, jenna.

jenna: Thanks everyone. Will follow up with a short checklist slack DM to the cohort leads. If anything blocks, report here. :sparkles:
